svg.title: Sabine — Juniperus sabina
svg.desc: A spreading savin juniper bough, with slender rounded branchlets covered in tiny, tightly appressed, overlapping opposite scale leaves, successive pairs set at right angles. Three small fleshy dark blue seed cones carry a pale wax bloom. A short, separate juvenile shoot bears only a few awl leaves. This is a botanical specimen of the toxic savin, not a culinary sprig.
